Summary:
TASK-002 passes all seven acceptance criteria. The `calculateRegionProgress` function in `src/peak-utils.js` is pure. It builds one entry per region found in `data/peaks.json`, sorted alphabetically using the same order as `getRegions`, and each entry has the region name, completed count, total and rounded percentage. `createRegionProgressItem` shows "completed / total peaks · N%" and adds a `role="progressbar"` element with `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="100"`, `aria-valuenow`, an `aria-label` ("<Region> completion") and `aria-valuetext`. In `app.js`, `handleToggleComplete` calls `updateProgressSummary`, which calls `renderRegionProgress`, so the breakdown updates straight away with no page reload. `index.html` adds a section labelled by its heading, and `style.css` adds a fluid grid (`minmax(260px, 1fr)`, which fits the roughly 280px of usable width on a 360px screen), a single column below 600px, and region names and counts that wrap. `git status` shows `data/peaks.json` is unchanged, so no regions were added or renamed. `npm test` ran 58 tests, all passed, and it exited with code 0.

Issues:
- None

Tests:
- `npm test`: 58 run, 58 passed, 0 failed, exit code 0. The first attempt didn't run any tests because of a shell syntax error on my side; the rerun with plain `npm test` worked.
- Region calculation tests: one sorted entry per dataset region; region totals add up to 100; a region with zero completed peaks (Eryri (Snowdonia)) shows 0%; a fully completed region (Lake District) shows 100% and other regions are unaffected; every region shows 100% when all peaks are done; partial percentages round correctly; unknown ids are ignored; an empty dataset gives an empty list; the inputs are not modified; marking then unmarking a peak updates the count both ways.
- Region rendering tests: name, "X / Y peaks" and percentage appear; every region has a progressbar with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-label`; fully completed regions get the complete class; HTML in region names is escaped; the section in `index.html` has a heading label; `app.js` re-renders the breakdown whenever progress updates.
- Responsive tests and code review: the fluid grid's minimum column width is 280px or less, which fits a 360px screen; the list is one column below 600px; names and counts wrap. These are checks on the CSS rules only. I didn't render the page in a browser.
- Checked by reading the code: toggling a peak calls `updateProgressSummary()`, which calls `renderRegionProgress()`, with no reload.
- `git status`: `data/peaks.json` has no changes.
- Earlier tests (dataset, progress, completion tracking, filtering, cards, responsive layout, server) all still pass.
